why: Naive start: the client uploads whole files to one service that stores bytes and metadata in one SQL database; other devices poll every 30 s. A 1-byte edit re-sends 50 GB, a dropped upload restarts, and the DB can't hold 2.5 EB.

nodes.label: Desktop / mobile client (watcher, chunker, local DB)

edges.label: upload whole file / poll for changes
